tools.name: get_collections
tools.description: Step 2. Looks up collection dates for the one property the user chose. Send the postcode and the field find_addresses named in required_input (normally property_id, from the chosen candidate). Waits up to about 45 seconds. status is done, partial (provisional dates), still_working (use check_lookup;

tools.name: check_lookup
tools.description: Reads a lookup that get_collections started, by its lookup_id. Waits up to about 30 seconds. Same statuses as get_collections. collections[].containers lists each distinct container group once: options are alternatives separated by 'or', each with a condition when the council states one, and items n

tools.name: get_schedule
tools.description: For a repeat check. Reads the stored schedule for a property_id that an earlier done lookup returned. It starts no new lookup; if it reports no_schedule, run find_addresses and get_collections again. collections[].containers lists each distinct container group once: options are alternatives separate

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "find_addresses" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
